page.overview:
Who is Funari?

Funari has a small dark-coloured goatee and wore a purple flak jacket. He also wears a black long sleeved shirt under his flak jacket. He also has a black strap holding a large, ornate blade to his back. He also has a sword hilt on his right hip meaning he is left handed and he also wears black shinobi sandals, a pair of greenish-coloured pants and a black bandana on his head.

He is presumably skilled in kenjutsu as he wielded a sword.

He was in charge of guarding the pawnshop where Kyōya and Ginji worked. He is attacked, and apparently killed by Suigetsu. In the anime, however, he was knocked out unconsious after being beaten up by Suigetsu.
